# Transcription

**Header (top right):** Alderwick Property Works — Move-Out Works Quotation
**Header (top left, small caps label):** CONTRACTOR QUOTATION

**Title:** Alderwick Property Works

**Quotation reference:** NBL-027-Q1
**Date:** 15 September 2025
**Property:** 46 Fernwick Lane, Aldermead, ZZ1 1ZZ

**Section: Labour & Materials**
- Repair damaged newel post.
- Address screw damage to a door frame.
- Fill holes in uPVC window frames.
- Make good wall damage.
- Fit a new door threshold and toilet-roll holder.
- Renew smoke detector.
- Rehang kitchen radiator.
- Renew an extractor fan.
- Renew an extractor fan.
- Renew en-suite radiator.
- Stain-block water-damaged ceilings.
- Reinstate decoration.

**Table**

| Description | Amount |
|---|---|
| Labour & Materials | £3,865.68 |

The page has no other text: no footer content, signature, terms or validity period.

# Unclear, missing or inconsistent

- **Duplicate line:** "Renew an extractor fan." appears twice. It is unclear whether this means two separate fans (for example, bathroom and en-suite) or an accidental repeat. No locations are given.
- **No itemised pricing:** The single total of £3,865.68 covers all 12 listed items, with no breakdown between labour and materials or per item.
- **No VAT information:** It does not say whether the amount includes or excludes VAT, and there is no VAT figure, subtotal or separate total line.
- **Missing contractor details:** There is no contractor address, phone, email, company number, VAT number or logo text beyond the name.
- **Missing client details:** It does not name who the quotation is addressed to (landlord, agent or tenant).
- **No validity or terms:** There is no quote expiry, payment terms, start date, duration or warranty.
- **Vague scope:** Several items lack locations or quantities, such as which door frame, which walls, which ceilings and how many windows. "Reinstate decoration" does not say which rooms or what finish.
- **Reference prefix:** The reference "NBL-027-Q1" has a prefix (NBL) that does not match the contractor name (Alderwick). This may be an internal or client code, but the document does not explain it.
- **Header wording:** The document is labelled "Move-Out Works", but no tenancy, checkout report or deposit reference is given to link the work to a move-out.

- Ceiling or water-damage defects in the kitchen, lounge, Bedroom 3, bathroom and en-suite.
- Altered decoration.
- Stained and faded carpets; replacement quotation requested.

(The text-layer version of the document renders "en-suite" as "ensuite" in the ceiling/water-damage item. The page image shows "en-suite", split across a line break. The text above follows the page image.)

**Footer:** None visible beyond a horizontal rule. There is a single page.

---

# Unclear, missing or inconsistent

- **No dates:** No inspection or checkout date, tenancy start or end date, or report date.
- **No names:** No tenant, landlord, agent, inspector or company named.
- **No amounts:** No costs, deposit figures or quotations. A replacement carpet quotation is requested, but no supplier or amount is given.
- **No locations or quantities:** Several items lack detail.
  - Which bedroom door frame, which upstairs window, and which staircase newel posts are affected.
  - Which rooms have wall holes or sticker residue.
  - Which radiators are rusting, other than the en-suite.
  - Which two extractor fans are non-working.
  - Which bulbs and how many are missing.
  - Which carpets are stained or faded.
- **Hedged wording:** "Reported," "apparently" and "or" indicate unverified findings. These are "reported water ingress," "reported non-working extractor fans," "apparently held with tape," and "Ceiling or water-damage defects."
- **No severity or responsibility:** Nothing distinguishes tenant damage from fair wear and tear or pre-existing issues. There are no photos or references to an inventory/check-in report for comparison.

- **Possible link between items:** The water-related items (kitchen worktop ingress, ceiling/water damage in five rooms, rusting radiators) may share a cause. The document does not say so.
- **No author or signature**, and no status such as draft or final.

input.message:
Dear Mr Vale,

Re: 46 Fernwick Lane, Aldermead, ZZ1 1ZZ — move-out works (our ref R/027)

Following our email earlier today and our attempted call, we need your decision on the quotation from Alderwick Property Works (ref NBL-027-Q1, dated 15 September 2025) so the property can be prepared for re-letting.

Quoted total: £3,865.68 (single "Labour & Materials" figure; the quote does not itemise prices or say whether VAT is included — we are confirming this with the contractor).

Work included: repair damaged newel post; make good screw damage to a door frame; fill holes in uPVC window frames; make good wall damage; fit a new door threshold and toilet-roll holder; renew smoke detector; rehang kitchen radiator; renew two extractor fans; renew en-suite radiator; stain-block water-damaged ceilings; reinstate decoration.

Not covered by this quote (from the checkout report): the boiler casing apparently held with tape, which needs inspection by a Gas Safe registered engineer; the warped kitchen worktop with reported water ingress (and the possible source of the water damage); kitchen flooring and chipped living-room laminate; the curtain pole, curtains and bulbs; other rusting radiators; and replacement of the stained carpets, which you asked to be quoted. We will arrange separate quotes for these if you would like.

Please reply APPROVE to go ahead with the Alderwick quotation at £3,865.68, or DECLINE. If you would also like us to obtain quotes for the excluded items (in particular the boiler inspection and carpets), please say so in your reply.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team, Northbridge Lettings

Read the checkout report and compared it with the quote. Not quoted: boiler casing, kitchen worktop and water ingress, kitchen flooring and laminate, curtain pole/curtains/bulbs, other rusting radiators, carpets
Property and contractor match (46 Fernwick Lane, Alderwick/Iris Bell)
No approvals, holds or lessons were on file
Safety: smoke detector and boiler items noted. Property is empty, so no immediate occupant risk
assumptions: The landlord's preferred channel isn't recorded, so I used email, the channel already used in event 14
The 'NBL' prefix on the quote reference is the agency's client code (Northbridge Lettings), not a mismatch

actions_taken.description: Moved the ticket from intake to landlord approval
Emailed the landlord to APPROVE or DECLINE quote NBL-027-Q1 at £3,865.68, listing what it includes, what it leaves out, and offering separate quotes for the boiler inspection, carpets and other items
Asked the contractor whether the price includes VAT, which rooms the two extractor fans are in, and for a rough cost split. Told her the quote isn't approved yet, so not to book
Put the ticket on hold waiting for the landlord, follow-up in 2 days
Recorded that the property is vacant and keys are at the office
Recorded that the boiler casing needs a Gas Safe inspection and isn't in the quote

escalation.reason: Routine wait for the landlord's approval; no follow-up deadline has passed yet
escalation.recommendation: If the landlord hasn't replied by the follow-up date, phone them through request_landlord_approval with channel 'call'. Escalate if they still don't respond after that.

unverified: Whether the quote means two separate extractor fans, and in which rooms
The state of the boiler and whether there is a current gas safety certificate
The cause of the water damage and water ingress
risks_or_red_flags: The taped boiler casing needs a Gas Safe engineer to inspect it before anyone moves in. It isn't in the quote, and I can't see a gas safety certificate on file
The top-floor smoke detector isn't working; it must work before a new tenancy starts
Water damage in five rooms plus water getting in at the worktop could share one cause. The quote stain-blocks the ceilings but doesn't look for the source
The quote has a single total with no item prices and no validity date
result.final_status: At landlord approval, on hold waiting for the landlord (approval 41, hold 283)

next_follow_up.what: Chase the landlord for APPROVE or DECLINE, by phone if no email reply. Check whether the contractor has answered about VAT and the fans.
